summary: BTC ~$81.3k, flat over 24h and holding the $80-82k range after Wednesday's tech-led sell-off. New since midday: Nasdaq approved Franklin Templeton's two equity-plus-5%-bitcoin dividend ETFs (FBEQ, FIBT), effective 27 Oct, which reinvest stock dividends into BTC; small but steady future demand. Futures data shows retail mostly absent. Nudged up from 0.03.
catalyst_note: Franklin Templeton FBEQ/FIBT bitcoin dividend ETFs approved on Nasdaq, effective 27 Oct 2026
